# Food Hacks

> Food Hacks (foodhacks.co) is a Kuwaiti food brand offering innovative, 100% natural non-stick cooking sprays that make healthy cooking easier: less oil, fewer calories, no artificial flavors or preservatives. Food Hacks is owned and manufactured by San Ramon, a Kuwaiti company founded in 2004 (sister brands: Karak Tea, Honey Al-Shahd, Food Experts).

## Products

- [Saffron Spray 200mL](https://foodhacks.co/product/saffron-spray-200ml/): Premium saffron cooking spray, 100% natural.
- [Extra Virgin Olive Oil Spray 200mL](https://foodhacks.co/product/extra-virgin-olive-oil-spray-200ml/): Extra virgin olive oil in an even-coverage non-stick spray.
- [Truffle Flavoured Extra Virgin Olive Oil Spray 125mL](https://foodhacks.co/product/truffle-flavoured-extra-virgin-olive-oil-spray-125ml/): Premium truffle-flavoured extra virgin olive oil spray.

Products can be ordered online at https://srkw.co/en/product-category/food-hacks/ (delivery usually within 24 hours of order confirmation).

## Facts

- The sprays let you cook with less oil than traditional methods, reducing calories and fat.
- No artificial flavors, coloring, or preservatives.
- Suitable for spraying foods before grilling or baking to improve flavor and reduce sticking.
- Designed to withstand normal cooking temperatures.
